name: test-app-dwi2b0
summary: Reproducible  pipeline to extract DWI b₀ volumes and, optionally, construct an unbiased b₀ template.

outputs.description: The mean non-diffusion-weighted (b0) image was generated by averaging all b0 volumes.
The 4D volume is constructed by concatenating all of the b0 images from the diffusion-weighted imaging series.

parameters.description: When this option is enabled, a b0 template is generated instead of computing a simple voxel-wise average of the b0 volumes.
